blocks.text: Scalp Micropigmentation for Fuller-Looking Hair Density

Scalp micropigmentation adds tiny pigment impressions to the scalp to create the look of fuller hair density. At Pomi B. Brow Studio in Tustin, each treatment is customized around your hairline, thinning areas, skin tone, and desired result.
Tiny pigment impressions for the look of fuller hair density.
Scalp micropigmentation is ideal if you want the look of more hair density
Scalp micropigmentation is a strong choice if your scalp shows through thinning areas, your hairline looks less defined, or you want the appearance of fuller coverage.
This service works well for clients who want a non-surgical cosmetic option to improve the look of hair density, scalp contrast, and hairline definition.
Add the look of more density where the scalp shows through.
Create a cleaner-looking hairline shape with custom planning.
Reduce the visual contrast between hair and scalp in sparse areas.
Plan the density, placement, and softness around your natural features.
Scalp micropigmentation, also called SMP, is a cosmetic tattoo service that uses tiny pigment impressions to create the look of hair follicles on the scalp.
The goal is to make thinning areas look denser, help the hairline look more defined, and create a natural-looking result that blends with your existing hair and skin tone.
Clients choose scalp micropigmentation when they want the look of more hair density without daily powders, fibers, or temporary scalp coverage products.
Create the visual effect of more density in thinning areas.
Improve the look of the hairline with custom placement and shape.
Match the pigment effect to your hair color, skin tone, and desired softness.
Reduce reliance on temporary products used to hide sparse areas.
Scalp coverage designed around your hair pattern
Your appointment starts with a consultation. Pomi reviews your hairline, thinning pattern, scalp tone, existing hair color, and desired density before treatment begins.
Talk through your thinning areas, hairline goals, and the look you want.
The treatment area, softness, and density are planned before pigment is applied.
Tiny pigment impressions are placed on the scalp, then you receive aftercare guidance.

Who is scalp micropigmentation best for?
SMP is a strong fit if you want to improve the appearance of thinning areas, scalp visibility, hairline definition, or overall hair density.

How many SMP sessions do I need?
The number of sessions depends on the size of the treatment area, the amount of density needed, and the final result you want. A consultation helps estimate the best plan.
How much does scalp micropigmentation cost?
The current price for Scalp Micropigmentation is $500 per hour. Confirm current pricing when booking, since rates are subject to change.
Where is Pomi B. Brow Studio located?
The studio is located at 2801 El Camino Real, Ste 13 in Tustin, CA, near Irvine and central Orange County.
Who should ask before booking scalp micropigmentation?
Ask before booking if you are pregnant, nursing, taking blood thinners, prone to keloids, have active scalp irritation, or have a skin condition in the treatment area.
